digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness gate and Epic Link field provisioning
propositions: serverInfo returning 200 does not imply GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered; the harness readiness gate waits only on serverInfo and ignores field inventory, creating a timing window where the instance appears ready but required fields are absent.

The harness survives flakes only due to incidental slowness downstream (dependency install, long test suite); if run faster or if the plugin initializes slower, _assert_project_capabilities fails and misattributes the timing flake to an image degrade rather than to premature readiness declaration.

The probe workflow (1387/3922f20d09) was fixed to wait on field inventory but the harness was not, violating AC4 (shared readiness definition); the two paths now diverge structurally and will continue to diverge.

A runtime experiment with stubbed transport (serverInfo→200, system-only field inventory) proved wait_for_jira_dc_ready returns ready having polled only /rest/api/2/serverInfo and never /rest/api/2/field, confirming structural blindness to the field inventory.

Gerrit 1406 (2613827564) established one shared readiness definition (scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py) delegated by both harness and probe, with bounded budget, self-diagnosing inventory dump on timeout, and explicit distinction between 'not registered yet' and 'image does not offer them' to prevent misattribution.
